answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 11663 Country: India Title: ASAK I have following query: Can a nektie be worn while offering Namaaz?? Thanking you in anticipation. Question: ASAK I have following query: Can a nektie be worn while offering Namaaz?? Thanking you in anticipation. Answer ID: 11663 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 510/510=M/1430) Wearing necktie is the way of non-Muslims, we Muslims should avoid adopting their ways always. Especially it is necessary to avoid it while perfuming salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
